messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update the existing Mosswood game so the joystick and interact button are off-screen, and the character cannot walk through walls, cabinets, or items.

## Requirements
- “Move joystick and interact button away from the screen.”
- “Character should not walk through walls and cabinets and items.”
- Build request: apply changes to the existing game, make reasonable assumptions without asking questions, and briefly note assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the project structure and confirmed it is an existing browser game.
- Confirmed the working tree was clean before changes.

### Active
- Locate the joystick, interact control, and character movement/collision code; implement the requested control placement and collision behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game-loop.js`, `game-ui.js`, `style.css`, and scene/art files to identify input controls, movement, and obstacle geometry.
2. Move the joystick and interact button outside the playable scene or remove their on-screen placement while preserving usable controls.
3. Add collision handling for walls, cabinets, and items; verify the character cannot pass through them.
4. Test the game in-browser if available and summarize assumptions and changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game scene markup and script loading order.
- `game-loop.js`: Likely animation and movement loop.
- `game-ui.js`: Likely input/control wiring.
- `style.css`: Layout and control positioning.
- `art-core.js`, `art-home.js`, `art-garden.js`, `art-outdoors.js`: Scene drawing and possible obstacle geometry.
- `data.js`: Game/location data.

## Important Context
- The game is titled Mosswood and renders its pixel-art world in `canvas#scene` (640×360).
- No files have been changed; the worktree remains clean.
